items.text: Rams HC Sean McVay expects WR Puka Nacua (groin/hip) to play Sunday vs Eagles; Schefter notes Rams get Nacua back as Eagles prep without Smith. Rapoport: slated to play.
items.why: McVay expectation; limited practice but trending up; no surgery needed.
items.implication: WR1 returns; Adams role may compress slightly but still viable.
items.opportunity: Full target share resumption for Nacua

items.text: Saints placing RB Travis Etienne on injured reserve due to hamstring injury.
items.implication: Out at least 4 games; Saints backfield opens for backups.

items.text: Packers placing WR Jayden Reed on injured reserve due to neck injury; out indefinitely if not for the season.
items.why: Neck injury requiring recovery; posted '11 out'.
items.opportunity: Higher snap/route share for remaining WRs/TE

items.text: Little optimism Eagles WR DeVonta Smith (hamstring) plays Sunday vs Rams; sidelined this week, expectation he won’t go.
items.implication: Eagles pass catchers elevate; Wicks/Goedert upside.

items.text: Jaylen Warren on LOVE list as top-10 play Week 4 (TNF); led RBs with 90% snap rate, 20/22 RB touches last week. Full workhorse with Dowdle out; CLE allows 88+ yards to RBs every game.
items.implication: Strong RB1/2 start; volume floor high.

items.text: Ravens Lamar Jackson and Zay Flowers among those upgraded to full participants on Thursday injury report.
items.implication: Both expected to play at full strength; offense unlocks.

items.text: Drake London LOVE Week 4 @ NO: 35% target share/104 ypg career with Penix; 43.5% share (9-194) in Penix return. NO allows 5th-most WR TDs.
items.why: Penix chemistry + high target share + matchup.

items.text: Seahawks designated RB Zach Charbonnet to return to practice.
items.why: Designated return; won't play this week but ready in ~3 weeks.
items.implication: Walker remains lead but committee looming soon; monitor handcuff.

items.text: Fresh ETR Rest of Season rankings live: Kenneth Walker ranked 3 overall. Notable also Parker Washington 22, Saquon Barkley 30.
items.why: Factored injuries, schedule, roles; Walker elite opportunity.
items.implication: Walker as top-tier RB1 ROS asset; high trade value.
items.opportunity: Lead back with clear path amid teammate recovery

items.text: Omarion Hampton HATE @ SEA: RB27 utilization, 3.5% target share, 25% routes; snap rate dropped to 42%, 13% third-down. SEA allows 2.9 YPC (2nd-fewest).
items.why: Poor usage trends + tough run defense.

items.text: Justin Herbert HATE @ SEA: Pressured 44% dropbacks; SEA 4th pressure rate, league-low 5.0 YPA/7.7 YPC. Chargers bottom-3 implied total.
items.why: Pressure + elite pass D + low total.

items.text: LOVE Garrett Wilson @ CHI (36% share w/o Mitchell, efficiency); Josh Downs vs WSH (31% share, 43% RZ, WSH worst vs WRs/slot); George Kittle vs DEN (climbing share/routes, Evans day-to-day, DEN soft vs TE).
items.why: Target share spikes + favorable matchups/usage trends.

items.text: HATE Kyle Pitts @ NO (16% share/34 ypg w/ Penix, TE37 util); Emeka Egbuka vs GB (1 RZ tgt, low total, new QB); Xavier Worthy @ LV (shrinking share as Rice climbs, low aDOT).
items.conflict: Aligns with Levitan Pitts usage data

items.text: Kyle Pitts has six targets through three games, none inside the 10-yard line, low aDOT; underperformed opportunity significantly.
items.why: Low volume, no red-zone, inefficient vs expected.
items.implication: Fade in rankings/start-sit; Penix connection not translating yet.
